t: This is the equestrian statue of Prince George, Duke of Cambridge, on Whitehall. It's life-size, by the sculptor Adrian Jones, with the setting designed by the architect John Belcher. Jones had been an army veterinary surgeon for twenty-three years before becoming an artist, and his knowledge of horses shows. The Duke was a grandson of George III and cousin of Queen Victoria, and he served as Commander-in-Chief of the Forces from 1856 to 1895. He was deeply devoted to the old Army, and worked with Queen Victoria to defeat or minimise reform proposals.
